desc: Ideation and approach selection: use one-dimensional cut-path DP instead of the 2D exact-count DP.
Implement the one-dimensional O(n^2) cut-path DP with prefix sums and the p>0 internal-cut penalty, returning dp[n] + k*totalCost.
Verify correctness on the two examples, n=1, one-subarray, all-singletons, and small random brute-force partitions.
Finalize the solution in the provided starter code with Python integer arithmetic and O(n^2) runtime.
